title: feat(post): Sodick wire skim passes state their flushing
body:
## What changed

- A wire machine file can state `edm.skim_flushing` (`high` or `low`). It is the flushing of each skim pass.
- `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` writes its T word (T84 / T85) before each skim's C word.
- The header of the program names the skim flushing word.
- `edm.skim_flushing` needs `edm.flushing`. The machine file parser, `Edm::is_sane`, `Edm::refusal` and the post refuse a file that states only the skim flushing.
- A skim on a machine that states `edm.flushing` and no `edm.skim_flushing` is refused by name. The app writes no file.
- A machine that states no flushing posts its skims as before (#2649).
- The post's machine mirror carries the key only when it is stated.
- The machine editor has a "Skim flushing" choice. It is enabled only while a flushing is stated.
- The MCP `edit_machine` tool takes the key through the same undoable machine patch. No new command is added.
- `assets/posts/wire-iso.cps` writes a note that a stated skim flushing is not programmed.
- `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` documents the key.
- The decision is in `docs/decisions/2686-sodick-skim-flushing.md`.

## Cause

Since #2649, the Sodick post writes each skim on its own C word. It wrote the flushing word after the threading only. A skim ran on the rough cut's flushing, and the program did not say so. The project had no value for the flushing of a skim.

## Behaviour change

A program with `edm.flushing` stated and skim passes posted before this change. The post refuses it now, until the machine file states `edm.skim_flushing`. The message names the key.

## Tests

Pins (each was red on unchanged code or with its guard removed):

- `crates/post/tests/sodick_skim_flushing.rs` (new, 6 tests):
  - `a_stated_skim_flushing_posts_its_t_word_before_the_skims_c_word`
  - `the_next_sections_rough_cut_selects_the_rough_flushing_again`
  - `a_skim_on_a_machine_that_states_only_the_rough_flushing_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_skim_flushing_without_the_rough_flushing_or_an_unknown_word_is_refused_and_nothing_is_cut`
  - `unstated_flushing_posts_a_skim_as_before` (green before and after: it pins the unchanged output)
  - `the_generic_wire_post_notes_a_stated_skim_flushing_it_does_not_program`
- `crates/app/tests/sodick_wire_passes.rs`:
  - `a_stated_skim_flushing_posts_its_t_word_before_each_skims_c_word` (the new golden, through the app's gate)
  - `a_skim_with_only_the_rough_flushing_stated_is_refused_by_name`
- `crates/post/src/machine/edm_dielectric.rs`:
  - `a_skim_flushing_parses_with_the_rough_flushing_and_is_refused_without_it`
  - `a_parsed_section_with_a_skim_flushing_and_no_flushing_is_not_sane`
- `crates/app/tests/mcp_edit_machine.rs`: `a_wire_tank_and_flushing_edit_is_one_undo_step_and_an_unknown_word_is_refused` (extended).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/machine_wire_edm.rs`: `the_wire_machine_editor_states_the_skim_flushing_only_with_a_flushing`.

Mutation results:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `sodick-wire.cps` and `wire-iso.cps` from `upstream/main` | RED: 5 of 6 in `sodick_skim_flushing`, 2 of 5 in `sodick_wire_passes`. Restored: GREEN |
| `parse_skim_flushing`: the "needs `edm.flushing`" guard removed | RED: `a_skim_flushing_parses_...`, `a_skim_with_only_the_rough_flushing_stated_is_refused_by_name`. Restored: GREEN |
| `Edm::refusal`: the skim flushing rule removed | RED: the `mcp_edit_machine` test. Restored: GREEN |
| `Edm::is_sane`: the skim flushing clause removed | RED: `a_parsed_section_...` at the `is_sane` assert. Restored: GREEN |
| `Edm::fits`: the skim flushing clause removed | RED: `a_parsed_section_...` at the `fits` assert. Restored: GREEN |
| `post::machine::mirror`: the key not written | RED: `a_stated_skim_flushing_posts_its_t_word_before_each_skims_c_word` (the post refuses the skim). Restored: GREEN |
| Machine editor: the enable rule and the reset removed | RED: the UI test. Restored: GREEN |

Gate, on the tree of the pushed head (base `e048b103c`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 664 steps, 0 failed (all post suites, all app suites, the `camcraft-ui` lib tests).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The gate ran without the compile cache (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`). The shared sccache server of this machine did not answer compile requests.
- `upstream/main` moved to `3970d3d03` during the gate. `git merge-tree` shows that the branch merges cleanly with it. The gate did not run on the merged tree.

## Author verification after review

Head: `51b3940ddb801d9b5fdcc033bbf332c7d2861e4a` (unchanged). Base at gate launch: `upstream/main` at `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95`. Another process moved the shared ref during verification. It resolved to `be3729d6b53bf76672d070ffc4a05b4c7363fb4c` at completion. The checks ran on the unchanged PR tree, not a merge with that newer main.

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN. All 184 steps passed in 24.2 minutes. The new shared golden selected every app heavy target.
- Raw heavy test totals: 42 passed and one expected failure. The explicit `known-fail1950` lane accepts `the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level` as a known failure. The test reports that the HSM plan cuts from air and exceeds the optimal load, so Offset rings replace levels. This is not an unexpected gate failure.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. 664 steps: 663 passed and one failed in 67.8 minutes. Test totals: 6,034 passed, seven failed, 50 ignored.
- The only failed step is the UI library. All seven failed tests report no graphics adapter. The review reported the same failures. All selected post, app and UI integration suites passed.
- The changed UI pin passed: `egui_app::tests::machine_wire_edm::the_wire_machine_editor_states_the_skim_flushing_only_with_a_flushing`.
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
- The gates used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.
- The source and goldens did not change during verification. No new code pin or mutation check applies to these two evidence findings.

## Goldens moved

- No existing golden changed (`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` shows one added file only).
- One new golden: `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-wire/wire_slug_punch_passes_flushed.nc`.
- The test derives it from the #2649 golden `wire_slug_punch_passes.nc`. The differences are:
  - the header line on tank and flushing becomes three lines (tank not programmed, T84 after threading, T85 before each skim pass);
  - `T84` after `T91`;
  - `T85` before `C002` and before `C903`.

## Machine editor captures

These images show the affected tank and flushing controls. A temporary harness renders the actual `dielectric()` function with egui. It uses the real machine types and the accessible-name helper. A CPU renderer draws egui meshes and the font texture. These are section captures, not desktop captures. No capture harness or image is on the PR branch.

Before: `e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a`. The editor has no Skim flushing control.

![Before: tank and flushing controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/632ada1a5abc9279ae867ca0a0bf8885c9dc1034/pr-2813/before.png)

After: `51b3940ddb801d9b5fdcc033bbf332c7d2861e4a`. Flushing is high. Skim flushing is low and the control is enabled.

![After: Skim flushing enabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/632ada1a5abc9279ae867ca0a0bf8885c9dc1034/pr-2813/after-enabled.png)

After, with no flushing stated: the Skim flushing control is disabled.

![After: Skim flushing disabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/632ada1a5abc9279ae867ca0a0bf8885c9dc1034/pr-2813/after-disabled.png)

The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `632ada1a5abc9279ae867ca0a0bf8885c9dc1034`.

## Not exercised

- The output was not run on a Sodick control.
- This PR did not read the LN1W / LN2W manual again. The position of the T word (immediately before the skim's C word) is inferred from the #1499 order.
- Pixel snapshots were not run (release lane).
- A skim flushing for each pass or for each condition row is not part of this PR (see the decision file).

## Overlaps

- #2554 changes `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs`. This PR does not change that file.
- No open PR changes the files of this PR.

Changelog: Sodick wire post: a machine file can state `edm.skim_flushing` (high / low); the post writes T84 / T85 before each skim's C word and refuses a skim when only `edm.flushing` is stated (#2686)

Effort: high

Fixes #2686
